comparison.objective: Lower a ratchet-held load to an intermediate tooth, verify the hold, then lower it to a rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transfer between crank and spring-returned pawl with staged regrasp.
comparison.success_condition: Intermediate native tooth hold must support the load after both grippers withdraw, followed by controlled lowering to the rest; numeric pose/force thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests reversible support transfer through a ratchet and pawl, not irreversible notch fracture or fragment cleanup.
